pages.text: If your body dies, it becomes a $(l)corpse$() that keeps your things, and you wake up in your head. As a jar, use a $(item)Suture Kit$() on the corpse to get back into it, or print a new body.
If your head is destroyed while you are out walking, that is a real death. Guard it. A $(item)Signal Jammer$() near your enemies works wonders.
